glosses: Characterized by all optimality conditions being satisfiable.

Government policy that attempts to influence the direction of the economy through changes in government spending or taxes.

A voluntary transfer of resources from one country to another.
A debt that a country, an organization in a country, or a resident individual in a country owes to those in other countries.
An aggregate amount of such debts.

Any market in which trade is unregulated by government; an economic system free from government intervention.
One who gets a free ride on a ship, or similar; one who rides on a means of transportation gratis.
Someone who obtains goods or services legally without paying.

A worker at an open shop who is able to enjoy the benefits negotiated by a union without being a member of the union.

glosses: International trade without government interference, especially from tariffs or duties on imports.

A type of unemployment explained by people being temporarily between jobs, searching for new ones; that is, because of inefficiencies in matching people to jobs and not because of a lack of available jobs.

To transfer using File Transfer Protocol.
An economic situation in which there is no cyclical unemployment.
An exchange in which one can trade on commodities or financial instruments at a specified price for delivery at a specified future time.
Of, relating to, or defined in terms of game theory.

An individual theory within that branch.
A state of simultaneous equilibrium as analysed in several or many interacting markets in an economy.
